definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.exchange_commit_application_workflow_publication(p_workflow_key text, p_home_university text, p_partner_university text, p_program_type text, p_academic_year text, p_application_round text, p_published_version integer, p_published_payload jsonb, p_published_at timestamp with time zone, p_current_revision_id text, p_updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    v_workflow public.application_workflows%rowtype;
begin
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('exchange-content-governance-command', 0));
    insert into public.application_workflows (
        workflow_key,
        home_university,
        partner_university,
        program_type,
        academic_year,
        application_round,
        published_version,
        published_payload,
        published_at,
        current_revision_id,
        updated_at
    ) values (
        p_workflow_key,
        p_home_university,
        p_partner_university,
        p_program_type,
        p_academic_year,
        p_application_round,
        p_published_version,
        p_published_payload,
        p_published_at,
        p_current_revision_id,
        p_updated_at
    )
    on conflict (workflow_key) do update set
        home_university = excluded.home_university,
        partner_university = excluded.partner_university,
        program_type = excluded.program_type,
        academic_year = excluded.academic_year,
        application_round = excluded.application_round,
        published_version = excluded.published_version,
        published_payload = excluded.published_payload,
        published_at = excluded.published_at,
        current_revision_id = excluded.current_revision_id,
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at
    returning * into v_workflow;

    return to_jsonb(v_workflow);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.exchange_community_display_name(p_profile jsonb, p_identity_mode text, p_content_type text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_school text := nullif(btrim(p_profile ->> 'verified_university'), '');
  v_department text := nullif(btrim(p_profile ->> 'verified_department'), '');
  v_real_name text := nullif(btrim(p_profile ->> 'display_name'), '');
  v_student_verified boolean := coalesce(
    p_profile -> 'student_status_verified' = 'true'::jsonb,
    false
  );
begin
  v_school := case regexp_replace(lower(normalize(coalesce(v_school, ''), NFKC)), '[^0-9a-z一-鿿]+', '', 'g')
    when 'cgu' then '長庚大學'
    when 'changgunguniversity' then '長庚大學'
    when '長庚' then '長庚大學'
    when '長庚大學' then '長庚大學'
    when 'nationaltaipeiuniversity' then '國立臺北大學'
    when 'ntpu' then '國立臺北大學'
    when '北大' then '國立臺北大學'
    when '台北大學' then '國立臺北大學'
    when '國立臺北大學' then '國立臺北大學'
    when '臺北大學' then '國立臺北大學'
    when 'nationaltaiwanuniversity' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when 'ntu' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when '台大' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when '台灣大學' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when '國立台灣大學' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when '國立臺灣大學' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when '臺大' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when '臺灣大學' then '國立臺灣大學'
    when 'tamkanguniversity' then '淡江大學'
    when 'tku' then '淡江大學'
    when '淡大' then '淡江大學'
    when '淡江' then '淡江大學'
    when '淡江大學' then '淡江大學'
    when 'ccu' then '國立中正大學'
    when 'nationalchungchenguniversity' then '國立中正大學'
    when '中正' then '國立中正大學'
    when '中正大學' then '國立中正大學'
    when '國立中正大學' then '國立中正大學'
    when 'ncu' then '國立中央大學'
    when 'nationalcentraluniversity' then '國立中央大學'
    when '中央' then '國立中央大學'
    when '中大' then '國立中央大學'
    when '中央大學' then '國立中央大學'
    when '國立中央大學' then '國立中央大學'
    else null
  end;

  if p_identity_mode = 'anonymous' then
    return '匿名學生';
  end if;

  if p_identity_mode = 'real_name' then
    return v_real_name;
  end if;

  if p_identity_mode = 'verified_school' and v_student_verified and v_school is not null then
    return v_school || '學生';
  end if;

  if p_identity_mode = 'verified_department'
     and v_student_verified
     and v_school is not null
     and v_department is not null then
    return v_school || ' ' || v_department || '學生';
  end if;

  return null;
end;
$function$
